name: What types of noise can noise-reducing windows block effectively?

mainEntity.name: What types of noise can noise-reducing windows block effectively?

acceptedAnswer.text: Noise-reducing windows are highly effective at blocking a wide range of external sounds. This includes common urban noises such as traffic (cars, trucks, motorcycles), construction sounds (jackhammers, heavy machinery), airplanes, trains, and general street chatter. They also reduce environmental sounds like barking dogs, loud music, and severe weather impacts. While they significantly diminish these noises, it's important to note that no window can achieve 100% soundproofing, but they provide substantial reduction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Noise-reducing windows effectively block urban sounds like traffic, construction, airplanes, and general street noise, significantly reducing their impact.
